style: calm, warm and credible documentary narrator for a short product film; clear, quietly confident, never rushed; <the beat's pace>
note: One Gemini TTS request per narrated beat (5 Nov 2026, free tier, the repo's KeyPool and synthesize(), counted on the shared ledger). Takes 2 and 3 retook lines read over 140 wpm or misheard (round 2, review v5: reading, limits and funding again, for 'Analyn', the phrasing of the limits and 'on a simulated sandbox'; round r2: the architecture's new line, why PayPal, take 3 kept over take 4, which both transcribers heard as 'funds in'); `pauses` edit a sentence pause at [seconds into the raw take, seconds]: a positive value inserts that much silence (a beat stays at or under 140 wpm without retiming the voice), a negative one cuts it out of the pause (highlights: the list's pauses are tightened so each reel clip keeps about 1.8 s and the phone clip 2.3 s, and the pause before 'Try to break it' grows so it lands on the reel's night cut at 55 s).

problem.pace: steady pace, about 125 words a minute; a short pause at each full stop

solution.pace: brisk but clear, about 140 words a minute; very short pauses at full stops; say 'Fair Split' as a name

architecture.pace: steady, about 130 words a minute; a short pause at each semicolon and at the full stop

highlights.pace: steady, about 125 words a minute; a short pause at each semicolon

paper.pace: steady and unhurried, about 120 words a minute; a short pause at the full stop

funding.pace: steady and unhurried, about 120 words a minute; say 'on a simulated sandbox' clearly, with the word 'on' given its full length

reading.pace: steady and unhurried, about 115 words a minute; give the name Analyn its full length, and a short pause at the semicolon

holds.pace: steady and unhurried, about 120 words a minute; a short beat after 'Refused'

signing.pace: steady and unhurried, about 120 words a minute; a short pause at the colon and at the semicolon

proof.pace: steady and unhurried, about 120 words a minute

member.pace: gentle and steady, about 125 words a minute; a short pause at the full stop

impressive.pace: steady, about 125 words a minute; a short pause after 'switches'

limits.pace: plain and matter-of-fact, steady, about 130 words a minute; a short pause at each full stop and at the semicolon

end.pace: slower and warm, about 115 words a minute; let the last sentence land
